remarks: Discover the Stone Gate complex in West Norwalk--an inviting community known for its careful management and peaceful atmosphere. Thoughtfully designed with mature trees, lush plantings, ample guest parking, and well-lit grounds, it offers a truly welcoming setting. Inside 130 Fillow St #21, you'll find a fully renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse with 1,148 sq. ft. of fresh, modern living space. The main level features an open-concept layout with a brand-new kitchen that flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas. Sliding doors lead out to a private deck--ideal for enjoying quiet mornings or evenings outdoors. Upstairs, two comfortable bedrooms and a full bath provide a restful retreat, while the main level includes a convenient half bath. A crawl-space basement adds valuable storage options. Perfectly positioned close to shopping, dining, schools, and commuting routes, this home combines style, functionality, and a prime location within a beautifully maintained community. Embrace easy, modern living in a setting designed for comfort and tranquility. Excellent credit, income required, 2 months security, no pets or smoking.
